SELECT r.card_id AS cardId, r.account_id AS accountId, r.user_id AS userId, r.card_num AS cardNum, r.expiry_date AS expiryDate, r.represent_yn AS representYn, COALESCE(c.card_num, CONCAT('KB국민 Custom Card (', r.card_id, ')')) AS cardName, COALESCE(u.name, '김국민') AS holderName FROM registered_card_tbl r LEFT JOIN user_tbl u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN card_tbl c ON r.account_id = c.account_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY r.represent_yn DESC, r.card_id ASC
